sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive leadership and Energy dominate as Healthcare surges into the top three, while cyclical sectors like Industrials and Basic Materials lose ground.

Market breadth remains narrow with only 3 of 11 sectors showing positive returns across all timeframes. Energy continues to command the top spot across multi-month horizons, backed by strong and sustained participation from Healthcare and Consumer Defensive. 

A clear rotation toward defensives is underway, highlighted by Healthcare's rapid climb over the past five sessions. In contrast, cyclical groups are fading, with Basic Materials and Industrials sliding multiple rank spots as momentum concentrates in a tight cluster of top-tier performers.

## Strength
- Only 3 of 11 sectors are all-green across weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and YTD horizons: Energy (momentum 0.88), Healthcare (momentum 0.87), and Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.73).
- Energy and Healthcare represent the only sustained leaders, holding top-3 positions across 1-, 3-, and 6-month rank windows.
- Technology maintains solid momentum (0.717) at rank 2, rounding out the cluster of groups with momentum scores above 0.70.

## Movers & Momentum
- Healthcare posted the strongest short-term advance, rising 3 spots over 5 sessions to reach rank 3 with a 0.867 momentum score.
- Basic Materials and Industrials were the sharpest weekly decliners, each dropping 2 spots to ranks 5 (momentum 0.383) and 6 (momentum 0.283), respectively.
- Energy leads all sectors with a momentum score of 0.883 (rank 1), while Utilities trails the broader market at 0.183 (rank 10).

## Divergences
- Consumer Cyclical is anchored at the bottom of the board at rank 11 with a 0.350 momentum score, decoupling from the upper tier led by Energy and Healthcare.
- Real Estate gained +1 spot to reach rank 8 despite carrying weak underlying momentum (0.267), reflecting minimal conviction behind the move.

- OUT: Communication Services -> IN: Real Estate - capital leaves softening growth communications (-1 spot, rs_slope=-0.403, regime=-0.15) for rate-sensitive Real Estate (+1 spot, wk=+2.2%, regime=+0.32).

- Consumer Defensive - RS cross trigger; confirm with sustained outperformance against SPY, while a quick reversal back negative invalidates the early rotation signal.

- Healthcare - RS new high trigger; confirm if the sector holds and extends its 20-session relative strength high versus the broader market, while a failure to hold this high mark invalidates leadership continuation.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and Healthcare dominate sustained leadership, while Materials and Industrials suffer sharp short-term rank deteriorations.

Leadership remains concentrated in traditional Energy and select Healthcare pockets, with 28 of 144 groups holding all-green status across all timeframes. Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing leads the market with top-ranked momentum (0.911, rank 1 YTD), closely tracked by Diagnostics & Research (0.896) and Oil & Gas Integrated (0.875). Short-term rotation is favoring commercial and consumer niches such as Business Equipment & Supplies (+19 spots to rank 40) and Shell Companies (+17 spots to rank 28), while Medical Distribution continues to compound gains (+15 spots to rank 40, momentum 0.872).

Conversely, Industrials, Basic Materials, and Cyclicals are sharply fading. Engineering & Construction dropped 25 spots to rank 49 (momentum 0.32), Silver slid 21 spots to rank 51 (momentum 0.47), and Agricultural Inputs declined 17 spots to rank 52 (momentum 0.38). In the lower tier, structural laggards remain deeply impaired, led downward by Mortgage Finance (momentum 0.017) and Gambling (momentum 0.038).

## Strength
- **Pervasive Energy Leadership:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing holds the highest momentum in the market at 0.911 (rank 1 YTD), reinforced by Oil & Gas Integrated at 0.875 momentum; both groups are all-green and sustained top-36 performers over 1, 3, and 6 months.
- **Healthcare Resilience:** Diagnostics & Research (0.896 momentum), Medical Distribution (0.872), and Health Information Services (0.869) maintain all-green status and rank among the top five absolute momentum leaders.
- **Sustained Multimonth Performers:** Beyond energy and healthcare, Department Stores (momentum 0.85) and Drug Manufacturers - General (momentum 0.80) remain entrenched in the top 36 across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top 5-Session Gainers:** Business Equipment & Supplies surged 19 spots (rank 40, momentum 0.75), followed by Shell Companies (+17 spots to rank 28, momentum 0.76) and Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries (+16 spots to rank 63, momentum 0.76).
- **Steepest Rank Declines:** Engineering & Construction fell 25 spots (rank 49, momentum 0.32), Silver shed 21 spots (rank 51, momentum 0.47), and Agricultural Inputs dropped 17 spots (rank 52, momentum 0.38).
- **Bottom-Tier Anchors:** Persistent momentum laggards continue to deteriorate at the bottom of the YTD rankings, including Mortgage Finance (0.017, rank 142 YTD), Gambling (0.038, rank 143 YTD), and Advertising Agencies (0.094, rank 144 YTD).

## Divergences
- **Tech & Growth Fading:** High-momentum segments are showing rank degradation over the past 5 sessions, notably Software - Infrastructure (momentum 0.73, down 5 spots), Semiconductors (momentum 0.65, down 6 spots), and Internet Content & Information (momentum 0.65, down 5 spots).
- **Early-Stage Rebounds:** Lower-momentum groups are demonstrating rapid rank improvement, led by Insurance Brokers (+11 spots, momentum 0.48), Leisure (+10 spots, momentum 0.50), and Travel Services (+6 spots, momentum 0.48).
- **Retail Turnarounds:** Home Improvement Retail jumped 5 spots despite a subdued momentum score of 0.35, while Grocery Stores gained 5 spots with a 0.45 momentum score.
